To calculate \( 17 \times 23 \), you can use the standard multiplication method:

\[
\begin{array}{r}
      17 \\
\times 23 \\
\hline
     51   (17 \times 3) \\
+ 340   (17 \times 20, shifted one place to the left) \\
\hline
    391  (17 \times 23)
\end{array}
\]

So, \( 17 \times 23 = 391 \).
